blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Police operatives arrested a 36-year-old woman for allegedly practicing dentistry without a license during an entrapment operation at her home in Santiago, Agusan del Norte. Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon, Police Regional Office-13 (PRO-13) director, said personnel of the Regional Intelligence Division-13 carried out the operation last Friday afternoon in coordination with the Santiago Municipal Police Station and officials of the Philippine Dental Association (PDA) Agusan del Norte Chapter and PDA Mindanao. Police identified the suspect only by her alias “Lang-Lang,” a resident of Purok 3 in Barangay San Isidro. Suguilon said the arrest took place […]...
